$comment: kro-pwa's own nen declaration -- one lane (web), the pnpm/Turborepo monorepo TOOLCHAIN.md and the Makefile already name as the canonical entry points. Every verb below is that Makefile's leaf command, cited by file and line in its 'why'; nothing here invents a command the repo does not already run. Scenario react-uzf-v1 (Stack Matrix Scenario 5 -- Web Only), per CLAUDE.md.

dependency.name: nen
dependency.minimum_semantics: MAJOR.MINOR, exactly two components. While nen's line is 0.x this means >=0.6.0 <0.7.0 EXACTLY -- at major zero the MINOR is the breaking-change vehicle, so a HIGHER minor is out of range too, not just a lower one. This declaration was originally merged with no `dependency` block at all, at nen 0.3.0 (`project.launch` was then preserved only as an unknown key, per the $comment below); this is its first pin, set directly at 0.6 rather than at the 0.5.0 floor `project.launch` itself would need, since 0.5 was never the merged state.
dependency.version_probe_output: a bare semver on stdout, e.g. '0.6.0' -- no 'v' prefix, no other text
dependency.$comment: What this repository needs FROM nen, as opposed to what nen runs IN it (`project`, below). `nen shu tools` synthesises a `nen` row from this block -- always verify-only, since re-pinning nen is `nen bootstrap`'s job and this repository's decision, never a side effect of a tools run. v0.6.0 is a PUBLISHED release carrying SHA256SUMS and the three platform binaries, which is what `bootstrap/nen.sh` verifies against; a tag with no release is refused at exit 6 by that script, so the pin is deliberately a released tag and not a branch or a bare tag.

web.why: The workspace dependency install has run. Nen ASSERTS this and never performs it: 'make setup' / 'corepack enable && pnpm install' is the repo's own precondition (TOOLCHAIN.md 'First run'; Makefile 'setup').

build.why: Makefile 'build' -> 'pnpm turbo run build', fanning out to each workspace member's 'next build' (apps/web/package.json).

test.why: Makefile 'test' -> 'pnpm turbo run test', fanning out to 'vitest run --coverage' in apps/web and 'vitest run' in the two packages.

lint.why: Makefile 'lint' runs both, in order: the repo-wide Biome pass, then the per-workspace lint fan-out (which also runs @kro/core's platform-free check and @kro/app's UZF-boundary check). Running only the second step is a weaker check than 'make lint' itself performs.

coverage.why: Makefile 'test-coverage', verbatim -- kept out of 'make test' and out of pr.yml on purpose (instrumentation roughly doubles the run; TOOLCHAIN.md). @kro/web's own 'test' script already runs 'vitest run --coverage' (apps/web/package.json), so the third step's lcov is real, not a gap. All three vitest configs declare 'reporter: ["text","lcov"]' with 'reportsDirectory: "coverage"' (packages/core/vitest.config.ts, packages/app/vitest.config.ts, apps/web/vitest.config.mts), so no reporter change was needed to name these paths. 'nen shu coverage' parses the first declared artifact whose format it recognises -- packages/core's lcov.info -- and reports the other two's existence without parsing them a second time.

ui-test.why: Makefile 'test-e2e', verbatim: the browser install is part of this verb, not a precondition, because the repo runs it every time (Playwright is not in pr.yml yet, TOOLCHAIN.md).

dev.why: Makefile 'dev' -> 'pnpm turbo run dev', fanning out to 'next dev' on :3000 (apps/web/package.json).

run.why: The production server (apps/web/package.json 'start' -> 'next start'). Requires a prior 'build': this repo has no Makefile verb for it at all -- the Makefile stops at 'dev'/'build' -- so nen states the production-serve invocation directly against the workspace member.

archive.unsupported: no packaging step exists for this lane. kro-pwa ships as a web application with no distributable artifact; the Makefile names no 'archive'-shaped verb and TOOLCHAIN.md documents none.

release.unsupported: Kro Web is a PWA -- there is no package or store pipeline. Makefile 'publish': "publish: n/a -- Kro Web is a PWA, there is no package or store pipeline. Releases ship via 'make deploy'."

deploy.unsupported: no target is wired yet -- host undecided, see TOOLCHAIN.md. Makefile 'deploy' is a stub that prints the open decision (Vercel vs Google Cloud Run) and exits 1 on purpose.

launch.$comment: project.launch is not read by nen 0.3.0 (preserved as an unknown key); the amaterasu skill reads it directly until 'nen shu dev --target' ships.

web.note: port precondition (3000, listening -> reuse) arrives with nen 0.4; until then the skill checks lsof by hand

evidence.$comment: project.evidence is not read by nen 0.3.0 (preserved as an unknown key). Globs are the RC-11 stories-mirroring snapshot tests that are this stack's actual UZF-26 evidence carrier (kro-pwa/.claude/rules/react-uzf-v1/12-session-completion-checklist.md) -- vitest text snapshots under packages/app, all six tracked in git today. No PNG evidence is committed anywhere in this repo: apps/web/e2e/kc71-shots.spec.ts and kc79-shots.spec.ts write screenshots only when an env var (KC71_SHOTS / KC79_SHOTS) points at an external directory, and apps/web/playwright-report is gitignored (apps/web/.gitignore) -- neither is a path a glob here could honestly name.
